prompts:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE fully painted opaque landscape image exactly 1536x1024 for a full-screen comic cutscene in Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. References are identity/style guides, not panels to copy. Match Riley to the supplied illustrated master, real face photo and sprite sheet: 16-year-old teen with youthful friendly clean-shaven face, light olive skin, short near-black dark brown hair with short straight fringe, thin BLUE rectangular glasses clearly visible, VERY muscular with huge bare biceps/shoulders and thick chest, true BLACK SLEEVELESS high-collar Asha'man coat with small silver sword pin, knee-length divided skirts, black fingerless gloves, trousers and boots. No sleeves, no beard, no chibi proportions. House style: hand-drawn HD 2D fighting-game art in spirit of Streets of Rage 4, strong near-black/dark-brown silhouette ink, fine interior lines, clean 2-3-step cel shading with subtle painterly gradients; detailed painted cutscene from same artist as character masters. Baerlon at rainy overcast dusk matching background reference: cold blue-grey sky and wet muddy cobbles, half-timbered houses, slate roofs, orange lanterns/windows, cool blue rim light and warm light on faces. Steady rain and puddle reflections. CRITICAL CROP SAFE COMPOSITION: every face and story-critical object wholly within y=100 through y=730; bottom 280 pixels only unimportant ground/clothing, top 90 pixels only sky/architecture. Fully painted to all edges, no borders or dialogue box. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, logos, signature, watermark or UI; any inn sign only pictures of stag and lion. Kid-friendly PG, no blood, gore, injury or weapon contact.
PANEL 1: WIDE SHOT of muddy road OUTSIDE Baerlon. Riley kneels in mud on LEFT, one hand on his knee, looking down with a determined worried expression at a clearly legible LINE OF LARGE HORSE HOOFPRINTS pressed into the mud near him. Put these important hoofprints around x=550-950,y=560-710, NOT in bottom quarter. Riley's youthful face with blue glasses at approximately x=400,y=330, bare huge shoulders and arms visible. Road leads RIGHT toward distant wooden palisade gate and gate towers with glowing lanterns, gate story silhouette around y=350-600. Grey rain clouds and puddles reflecting lantern glow. Only Riley appears; no horse or other characters in this panel.
checks: Inspected original full resolution. Riley: youthful clean-shaven face, short dark fringe, visible blue rectangular glasses, black sleeveless coat/silver pin, huge bare muscles.
Hoofprint trail readable above dialogue area; nearer redundant prints extend into lower ground. Palisade gate and rainy lantern palette visible.
No visible text, logos, blood, injury or violence.
